notes: DCA 6-2015 Table 2 (p. 4), Maximum Joist Spans and Overhangs, under the Connecticut 2022 pack. Each hand-authored expectation was read from the rendered page (PDF sha256 205d57b5...3009e), not exported from the pack: per row, a span case (12" rows 6" under L_J, 16" rows 3" over, 24" rows 1" under) and a cantilever case asked on a span long enough that the row's printed L_O governs (JOIST SIZE, p. 3: the lesser of L_O or L/4; for the three rows whose L_O is more than a quarter of L_J the span is 4 x L_O, and a second case at L_J shows L/4 governing). Then a case per guide scope limit, the note's worked example (2x8 at 16", Southern Pine, 9'-9"), and the column refusals. The generated cases are GoldenRunner.DeckBoundaries' output, committed.
